newsitem.title: UK: First Channel Tunnel drug smuggler gets 11 years.
newsitem.headline: First Channel Tunnel drug smuggler gets 11 years.

text.p: The first person caught trying to smuggle drugs into Britain through the Channel Tunnel was on Friday sentenced to 11 years in jail after police found he was carrying cocaine worth 527,000 pounds ($815,000).

Student Stanley Aspinall's bid to make a fortune ended when police at London's Waterloo International station discovered four kg (nine lbs) of the drug hidden in his suitcase after he arrived from Paris on the Eurostar train service.
Aspinall, 19, described as "tragic and unsophisticated" by his lawyer, bought the cocaine in Thailand.
